_doc: Tier-C former districts whose WD items were hand-created (batch #261329, 2026-07-20) because Wikidata had no former-district item, only the 2025 successor. Keyed by district local_id → {successor QID, the province cấp-xã arrangement resolution that created the successor}. build_districts_all emits both succession directions (P1366 on the former item, P1365 on the successor) into statements/na-districts.qs, referenced here — this carries the P1365 back-links that the manual batch's LAST-as-value lines could not. See docs/journals/2026-07-19.02.
